sentences.en: Rich alluvial diamond deposits make Namibia a primary source for gem-quality diamonds.
sentences.zh: 丰富的冲积金刚石矿藏使纳米比亚成为优质宝石级钻石的主要来源地。

sentences.en: The river carries alluvial sediments downstream.
sentences.zh: 河水携带冲积沉积物向下游流动。

sentences.en: Farmers often use alluvial soil to grow crops in the floodplains.
sentences.zh: 农民经常利用冲积土在洪泛平原种植农作物。
